fixes.explanation: That's a sweet thought, friend, but it's not the word Paul uses. He says, "…when we are clothed, we will not be found naked." (2 Corinthians 5:3) Picture showing up to the bakery at 5 a.m. with no apron on. THAT is the kind of moment he has in mind, and it's a lot more exposed than lonely.
